messages:
Sam: Thanks for the great all-hands earlier — quick open thread to capture the leadership Q&A follow-ups on sales/pipeline/GTM/partners. I want to convert the verbal asks into owners and clear next steps. Posting the three high-priority items that leadership flagged + my suggested owners. Please reply with OK + concrete ETA (day/time) or reassign. @Priya @Diego :raised_hands:

Sam: 1) Pipeline definition for product-led qualified leads — leadership asked we standardize what 'sales-ready' means for PLG accounts (MQL -> SQL criteria, expected ARR threshold, and tech fit). Suggested owner: Priya. ETA: EOD Fri?

Priya: Ack. I can draft a one-pager today and share a short rubric by Thu noon. Will sync with Maya on conversion criteria (CS input).

Maya: +1. I'll pull recent PLG-to-paid conversion cohorts and highlight the ARR breakpoints that align with successful expansion. Plan to share notes by Thu afternoon.

Sam: 2) Partner-led deals handoff playbook — leadership wants clarity on which partner motions need SE involvement vs. partner enablement only. Suggested owner: Diego + Omar for technical checklist.

Diego: I'll own the partner playbook doc. Proposal: two flows — "referral" (partner hands off qualified opp, Redwood SE tkt opens) and "co-sell" (joint demo, partner remains primary). Omar, can you draft a minimal technical enablement checklist we can share with partners?

Omar: Yep. I'll put together a short checklist with required integration points, sandbox creds, and a one-page runbook for demos. Will post a draft in this thread by Fri 11am.

Sam: 3) Demo SKU / pilot pricing clarity — leadership asked for a default pilot offer for mid-market (to speed approvals). Suggested owner: Clara + Zoe for billing/ops constraints.

Clara: I'll propose two pilot SKUs: "Pilot-30" (30-day, limited tokens, low-touch) and "Pilot-90" (longer evaluation with staging instance). Need Ops on any billing limitations or contract minimums.

Zoe: Ops notes — we can map these SKUs into one-off invoice items, but subscriptions with auto-convert need legal review. For Pilot-90 we might need a short SOW. I can confirm by Thu EOD.

Sam: Other quick asks from leadership: a) rollup metric for "time-to-first-value" for PLG accounts (owner: Priya + Clara), b) partner success onboarding SLA (owner: Diego + Maya).

Priya: Happy to own the TFV metric. Clara — can you add the metric to the product roadmap board so we track it alongside funnel work?

Clara: Added TFV metric to the roadmap board and linked it to two epics (onboarding flows + product signals).

Diego: I'll draft a partner onboarding SLA, including a 2-week timeline for technical enablement and a 30-day joint success plan.

Sam: Small ops/coord ask — can we have a single shared doc (one pager) summarizing these items for exec review? I'll compile once the owners post drafts.

Priya: I'll create a Google doc and share here when the draft is ready.

Omar: Posted a short draft checklist to the "eng-runtime" channel and will paste a link here shortly.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy to staging tonight 23:30 UTC — may affect demo environment. :warning:

Zoe: Thanks @deploy-bot — if deploy hits staging we should freeze all partner demo bookings after 23:00 UTC. I'll add a note in the calendar invite.

Sam: Great — thanks all. If you can't meet the suggested ETA, please reassign now or state blockers. I'll follow up with a compiled doc tomorrow morning for execs. :thumbsup:
